claims: Porto is a historic coastal city in northwest Portugal.
Porto is the birthplace of port wine.
Historic cellars line the Vila Nova de Gaia riverbank across from Porto.
Ribeira District is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Dom Luís I Bridge is a double-deck metal arch bridge.
Dom Luís I Bridge offers panoramic views.
Livraria Lello is a historic bookstore.
Livraria Lello is often associated with J.K. Rowling's Harry Potter inspiration.
Majestic Cafe is a historic 1920s cafe.
Student uniforms in Porto include capes.
Student uniforms in Porto resemble the costumes in the Harry Potter books.
Braga is a nearby historic city to Porto.
Guimarães is a nearby historic city to Porto.
